description: Covers B41, B59. engine_sites rows get value_offset, an anchor before an opcode whose value follows an absolute address (B41), and patch rows may name an int or float config_keys key (value_key) whose value the proxy writes as the immediate, only when it differs from stock, logging it (B59); files: the engine_sites schema, gen_tables.py, patch_engine.h, patch_driver.cpp, a float key type in config.h, the patch engine host test. Unblocks napoleon J27.
title: Engine-site patch values: value_offset and numeric values from config keys
